Scegli dove si vede il selettore di ling: Choose where the language switcher shows
Non ho trovato il componente della testa: The Etch header component was not found: the switcher stays floating. You can place it from Settings → Switcher.
Il selettore di lingua non compare nella: The language switcher does not show on the home page: Etch's menu is a component, not a WordPress menu. Settings → Switcher has “Put the switcher in the header”, or turn on the floating switcher.

The language switcher does not show on the home page: the theme uses no menu Lingua Bridge can reach. In Settings → Switcher turn on the floating switcher, choose another menu, or copy the shortcode to put in the header.
Il selettore di lingua (fluttuante, nel: The language switcher (floating, in the menu, in the Etch header, block and shortcode) and what happens when a visitor reads another language are in the “Switcher” tab.
Dove si vede il selettore di lingua?: Where does the language switcher show?
Fluttuante, in un angolo della pagina: Floating, in a corner of the page
Si vede subito su ogni pagina tradotta,: Shows at once on every translated page, without touching the theme; it goes away where another switcher is already there.
Il blocco del selettore entra nel compon: The switcher block goes into the header component and its translated versions, after a copy that can be restored from Settings → Switcher.
I codici delle lingue in fondo al menu p: The language codes at the end of the main menu (or of the block theme's navigation).
Con il blocco «Selettore lingua — Lingua: With the “Language switcher — Lingua Bridge” block or the [lingua_bridge_switcher] shortcode; the options are in Settings → Switcher.
Un visitatore che legge un’altra lingua: A visitor who reads another language
Portalo nella sua lingua alla prima pagi: Take them to their language on the first page, if it exists (recommended)
Proponigli la sua lingua con una piccola: Offer their language with a small bar
Componente della testata non trovato, o: Header component not found, or you cannot edit it.
Scegli il componente dell’originale: le: Choose the original's component: its versions in the other languages get the switcher with it.
Non puoi modificare una delle versioni d: You cannot edit one of the component's versions: none was changed.
Selettore messo nella testata: %d compon: Switcher put in the header: %d components changed. The copies from before can be restored from here.
Nessuna pagina del sito ha ancora mostra: No page of the site has shown a switcher yet. The floating switcher appears by itself where there is no other.
Mostralo nelle pagine dove non c’è un al: Show it on the pages that have no other switcher.
È HTML stampato dal sito: funziona senza: It is HTML printed by the site: it works without JavaScript, with the keyboard and in static copies. It goes away by itself on pages that already have the switcher in the menu, the block, the shortcode or the Etch component.
Niente bandiere: una lingua non è un pae: No flags: a language is not a country. The colors come from the theme.
Lo stesso codice del sito, con le home d: The same code as the site, with the homes of the languages. Save to see new choices.
Su Etch il menu è un componente, non un: On Etch the menu is a component, not a WordPress menu: use “Put the switcher in the header” below.
Everyone sees the page they asked for.
Una piccola barra con il nome della ling: A small bar with the name of the browser's language, if the page has it. Closed once, it does not come back.
Alla prima pagina della visita, se è nel: On the first page of the visit, if it is the original and there is a version in the browser's language, the visitor goes there. Never for search engines, never when arriving from a link to a language, and the choice made with the switcher always wins (it stays in the browser, without cookies).
Tutto avviene nel browser leggendo gli h: Everything happens in the browser, reading the page's hreflang: it works with caches and in static copies, and nobody sees different pages at the same address.
Non ho trovato il componente della testa: The header component was not found: place it by hand with the “Language switcher — Lingua Bridge” block or the shortcode below.
Metti il selettore nella testata: Put the switcher in the header
Aggiunge il blocco del selettore (tendin: Adds the switcher block (a dropdown with the codes) at the end of the header's navigation, also in its versions in the other languages. First it copies each component, which can be restored from here. Then you move or edit it in Etch like any other element.
Ripristina «%s» com’era prima del selett: Restore “%s” as it was before the switcher
Nell’editor a blocchi: il blocco «Selett: In the block editor: the “Language switcher — Lingua Bridge” block, with the same choices in the sidebar. Elsewhere (widgets, Etch, classic themes) the shortcode:
Anche le lingue senza questa pagina (por: Also the languages without this page (they lead to their home)
una tendina che si apre senza JavaScript: a dropdown that opens without JavaScript; without it: a list in a row.
IT, EN oppure «IT · Italiano»; senza: il: IT, EN or “IT · Italiano”; without it: the language's name.
mostra anche le lingue senza questa pagi: also shows the languages without this page, leading to their home.
Meta della pagina (titolo e descrizione: Page meta (title and description for search engines and social media)
Le variabili del plugin SEO (come %%titl: The SEO plugin's variables (such as %%title%% or %sep%) must stay those of the original.
Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress o Slim SEO: c: Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress or Slim SEO: copied and sent for translation
Ogni lingua ha la sua versione; finché n: Each language has its own version; until you save it, a language shows the original's options.
Facoltativo, con i prefissi accesi: una: Optional, with prefixes on: one line per base, the language, the original's base and the translated one (fr category categorie, de author autor, fr eventi evenements). The addresses of that language use the translated base; those with the original's base lead there with a 301.
Copia, anche quando l’originale cambia: Copy, also when the original changes
Ignora: la traduzione non lo riceve: Ignore: the translation does not get it
I contenuti non hanno ancora campi perso: The contents have no custom fields yet.
«Traduci» manda il campo all’agente, all: “Translate” sends the field to the agent, to XLIFF and to the automatic service; “Copy” brings it from the original at every save; “Ignore” does not copy it. ACF and Etch text fields are translated by default.
Pagina genitore (la sua versione nella l: Parent page (its version in the language, if any)
Commenti e ping aperti o chiusi: Comments and pings open or closed
Categorie, tag e altri termini (le loro: Categories, tags and other terms (their translated versions, if any)
Quando salvi l’originale, questi dati pa: When you save the original, these data reach all its translations, published ones too: they are not texts, so no translation changes words. A translation you cannot edit stays as it is.
